title: ZeroTrustMeshDashboardEvents
description: Initial security events tracked by the PQC Zero-Trust Mesh Observability Dashboard

events.description: Triggered when an unauthorized identity or forbidden route access is blocked by OPA policy evaluation.

fields.sourceIdentity: SPIFFE ID or service name of caller
fields.path: Requested URL path or API route

sample.reason: Access denied: unapproved identity or unauthorized destination

events.alertThreshold: > 5 events within 1 minute from the same source identity

events.description: Triggered when mTLS handshake fails, cryptographic signature verification fails (ML-DSA / Dilithium / ECDSA), or an expired/invalid SPIFFE verifiable identity document (SVID) is presented.

fields.tlsCipherSuite: Attempted cipher suite (e.g., Hybrid ECDH + ML-KEM-768)
fields.failureReason: Handshake error details (e.g., untrusted CA, invalid signature, expired cert)

sample.failureReason: mTLS verification failed: client certificate signed by untrusted authority

events.description: Triggered when unexpected shell execution, container breakout attempt, privilege escalation, or unauthorized administrative command is executed within mesh workload pods.

fields.podName: Kubernetes pod name where command executed

events.alertThreshold: Immediate alert on any critical command execution

events.description: Triggered when Post-Quantum (ML-KEM/ML-DSA) or classic certificates, SPIFFE SVIDs, or mesh mutual TLS credentials are scheduled, rotated, or renewed.

fields.serviceIdentity: SPIFFE ID of the rotated service
fields.rotationType: Scheduled rotation, automated renewal, or emergency revocation

events.alertThreshold: Alert on rotation failure or certificates expiring within 1 hour
